name: MediaFetch Pro Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: v1.5.2: Fixed Behance multi-media extraction extracting all high-res photos and videos with selection modal; Fixed Instagram download analyze loop ensuring direct download queues immediately; Fixed Instagram preview player audio restoring full unmuted sound.
Fixed links across all platforms: LinkedIn, TikTok, Behance, Fiverr, Dribbble, Apple Music, and universal web media.
Multi-Image & Carousel support: full extraction of all slides, images, and video portfolios with batch and zip download options.
Added Songs feature matching the plugin: search and download high-res tracks via Apple Music / iTunes and Jamendo 320kbps MP3.
New Orientation filters: 16:9 Landscape and 9:16 Portrait / Shorts for Videos and Photos.
New Songs sub-filters: All, Songs, Playlists, Artists, and Albums.
Massively increased search results volume across all search engines.
